citationText: Personal Correspondence With Ed Giorgianni. On September 14, 2018, Jake Zuena and Ed Giorgianni engaged in a discussion surrounding esthetic perturbations added to consumer films based on the results of unpublished color-preference studies run by The Eastman Kodak Company.
